title: 泰佩思琦上调全年指引 全球需求韧性支撑增长
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I know we've talked a lot about the momentum that we continue to see in tapestry, particularly with the coach brand, but give me a sense here.
segments.zh: 我知道我们多次谈到泰佩思琦持续增长的势头，尤其是蔻驰品牌，但请具体说说。

segments.en: You had enough confidence to raise your forecast. At a time where a lot of people are talking about the state of the economy, a lot of people are talking about, not just whether people have the money to spend,
segments.zh: 你们有足够信心上调预测。在很多人讨论经济状况、讨论人们是否有钱消费时，

segments.en: but whether they're willing to spend it. What gave you the confidence to raise your guidance?
segments.zh: 更讨论他们是否愿意消费。是什么给了你们上调指引的信心？

segments.en: Well, you know, we just came off a quarter, Romaine, that we beat expectations.
segments.zh: 嗯，Romaine，我们刚结束一个超预期的季度。

segments.en: A really, I would say, another strong quarter.
segments.zh: 可以说，又是一个强劲的季度。

segments.en: It shows the compounding growth we're able to deliver, going really from strength to strength.
segments.zh: 这体现了我们能够实现的复合增长，真正不断壮大。

segments.en: We came off of a very strong year last year. And what we see in our business is it's strong around the world.
segments.zh: 去年我们表现非常强劲。我们看到业务在全球都很强劲。

segments.en: It's strong in North America, which is our biggest region, and we're winning there.
segments.zh: 在北美这个最大市场表现强劲，我们在那里取胜。

segments.en: We're winning in Asia with China as our anchor there.
segments.zh: 我们在亚洲取胜，以中国为锚点。

segments.en: We're winning in Europe. We're really broadcasting broad-based gains.
segments.zh: 我们在欧洲取胜。我们确实实现了广泛增长。

segments.en: And so that's what gave us the confidence to raise our outlook for the year.
segments.zh: 这让我们有信心上调全年展望。

segments.en: And I think more important than what we delivered last quarter is how we're delivering it.
segments.zh: 我认为比上季度业绩更重要的是我们如何实现它。

segments.en: And the capabilities we're building to deliver this durable growth.
segments.zh: 以及我们为持续增长所构建的能力。

segments.en: Well, give me a sense here as to how you're actually delivering that.
segments.zh: 请谈谈你们具体是如何实现的。

segments.en: So when we talk about the potential increase in revenue, is that because people are buying more goods from tapestry or is it a function more of pricing?
segments.zh: 收入增长是因为人们买了更多产品，还是主要来自定价？

segments.en: Well, it's all part of the equation, but as we've talked about on the show before, our anchor point is really it starts with the consumer.
segments.zh: 这是综合因素，但正如我们之前所说，起点始终是消费者。

segments.en: And we work to understand the consumer at a very deep level.
segments.zh: 我们致力于深入理解消费者。
